package settings

import (
	"bytes"
	"sort"
)

func Render(settings map[string]string) ([]byte, error) {
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(settings))
	for key := range settings {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)

	var rendered bytes.Buffer
	rendered.WriteByte('{')
	for index, key := range keys {
		if index != 0 {
			rendered.WriteByte(',')
		}
		rendered.WriteByte('"')
		rendered.WriteString(key)
		rendered.WriteString("\":\"")
		rendered.WriteString(settings[key])
		rendered.WriteByte('"')
	}
	rendered.WriteByte('}')
	return rendered.Bytes(), nil
}
